dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute; minimal pixel radius forming a sharp, needle-like tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep incline, approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the visible base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Narrow profile; vertical height is roughly 2.6 times the visible base width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Primary V-shaped notch or traumatic tissue loss located on the mid-posterior margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Hyper-tapered, elongated dorsal extension resulting in an atypically thin vertical profile.
